## Summary

<!-- What does this change do, and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build / CI / tooling
- [ ] Refactor (no behavior change)

## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] `npm test` passes
- [ ] Added or updated tests for changed pure logic
- [ ] No secrets, cookies, session files, or browser profiles committed
- [ ] No raw `console.log` output added to server modules (use `console.error`; the stdio stream must stay valid JSON-RPC)
- [ ] Docs (`README.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md`) updated when behavior changes
